_about: Where each CORES unit is, shown in the Daily Report's Snapshot as 'Loc ...', in the Location block's tooltip, in the Unit filter and as Breakdown > By location.
Key = the unit exactly as CORES prints it (case does not matter). location = free text, kept short because it prints on every patient, e.g. 'North Pavilion 7'.
verified = false prints the location with a '?' after it; set it to true once you have confirmed it. A unit with an empty location shows nothing.
cores generate names any unit on the report that has no location here yet. Unit names are not PHI; never put patient details in this file.

UED.source: Wikipedia's UAB Hospital article puts the Emergency Department on the North Pavilion's first floor; not confirmed on a UAB page
